runs.text: In the series 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, … each term is the sum of the two before. You have to compute term 30. Which approach is best?
Direct recursion branches: term 30 asks for 29 and 28, 29 asks for 28 again, and so on. A loop remembers the last two terms and repeats nothing.

justification.text: Each call opens two more calls, and the same terms are computed again and again: more than a million calls.

runs.text: With a loop that carries the last two terms.

justification.text: Thirty passes are enough, and each term is computed only once.

runs.text: It makes no difference, because both give the same result.

justification.text: They give the same, but one takes thirty steps and the other more than a million.
